the application aims to teach children reading and writing skills in Arabic and English languages, mathematics skills, general and geographical information, and the Holy Qur’an in an interactive manner that praises the children and warns them of their mistakes using interactive cartoon characters.

Section one: Arabic language
1. Reading the letters of the Arabic alphabet in an interactive, lyrical way that enables the child to memorize the letters and identify examples of words that begin with them.

2. Training in tracing Arabic letters on the line using an interactive whiteboard and an eraser.

3. Letters test, in which the child listens to the name of the letter and chooses the correct form from multiple options. Pictures of things that begin with the letters also be shown so children can choose from multiple options.

4. Reading by displaying words divided into pronounced syllables written with harakaat (Fatha – Damma – Kasra).

5. Dictation, in which the children can form the words that are dictated to them by voice by touching the letters on the screen and rearranging them.

6. Dictate the names of the animals shown in the pictures.

7. The positions of the Arabic alphabets in the beginning, middle and end of words in their connected and separate forms, with examples.

8. Pronunciation of letters with harakaat (Fatha - Damma - Kasra) with examples and pictures.
